properties.title: Academy House refurbishment reached built status
properties.explanation: The seven-storey Oxford Street building was documented as refurbished and reclad with a terracotta faience facade.

properties.title: Aga Khan Centre inaugurated at King's Cross
properties.explanation: A new education, research, and cultural building entered institutional use in the King's Cross Knowledge Quarter.

properties.title: Alexandra Palace Theatre and East Court reopened
properties.explanation: A long-closed Victorian theatre and palace entrance returned to public cultural use.

properties.title: Battersea Arts Centre Grand Hall reopened
properties.explanation: A restored performance hall inside the Grade II* listed former town hall returned to public cultural use.

properties.title: Bobby Moore Academy Secondary School was listed as built
properties.explanation: The project record documents a 9,240 square metre secondary school on a constrained Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park site, providing education and community facilities for the growing neighbourhood.

properties.title: Boxpark Wembley launched on Olympic Way
properties.explanation: A container-based food, drink, leisure, and events venue entered use beside Wembley Stadium.

properties.title: Cannon Green refurbishment reached built status
properties.explanation: A mixed-use workplace refurbishment at 27 Bush Lane was documented with a double-height glazed podium and new restaurant, gym, and bike-club amenities.

properties.title: Coal Drops Yard opened at King's Cross
properties.explanation: A major adaptive-reuse and public-realm project opened within the King's Cross regeneration area.

properties.title: Gasholders London completed at King's Cross
properties.explanation: Restored Victorian gas-holder guide frames entered new residential use around contemporary apartment buildings.

properties.title: Goldsmiths Centre for Contemporary Art opened
properties.explanation: A new contemporary-art gallery entered public use on the Goldsmiths campus in New Cross.

properties.title: Great Arthur House recladding reached built status
properties.explanation: The Grade II-listed residential block at 108 Golden Lane was documented with replicated replacement cladding and modern double-glazed facade units.

properties.title: Hackney Wick station transformation was unveiled
properties.explanation: A rebuilt station entrance, ticket hall, underpass, stairs, lifts, and access arrangement entered public railway use at Hackney Wick.

properties.title: Hawley Primary School's new Camden building officially opened
properties.explanation: A purpose-built primary school building entered civic education use as part of the wider Hawley Wharf redevelopment context.

properties.title: The Horizon Building reached built status in Ilford
properties.explanation: A dated office building at 24 Ilford Hill was documented as converted into 122 homes.

properties.title: Horniman World Gallery opened
properties.explanation: A 600 sq m museum gallery entered public use inside the Horniman's original Forest Hill building.

properties.title: A House for Writing reached built status
properties.explanation: A small side-return extension to a London terraced house was documented as complete, adding a compact writing space.

properties.title: International House Brixton affordable workspace was listed as built
properties.explanation: The project record documents the use of the 12-storey International House as a 70,000 square foot affordable workspace for entrepreneurs, cultural groups, and nonprofits.

properties.title: Japan House London opened in Kensington
properties.explanation: A new public cultural venue entered use on Kensington High Street.

properties.title: Kew Temperate House reopened after restoration
properties.explanation: A Grade I listed Victorian glasshouse returned to public visitor use after large-scale restoration.

properties.title: Kiln Theatre reopened after architectural renovation
properties.explanation: A refurbished theatre, cinema, bar, restaurant, and rehearsal-space building returned to public cultural use on Kilburn High Road.

properties.title: London Bridge station redevelopment officially reopened
properties.explanation: A major transport architecture and station-capacity redevelopment was completed at London Bridge.

properties.title: London Bridge station officially reopened after redevelopment
properties.explanation: A transformed rail station with new entrances, a large concourse, rebuilt platforms, lifts, escalators, and retail space entered its post-redevelopment operating state.

properties.title: Mansfield Road Studio reached built status
properties.explanation: A house at 102 Mansfield Road was documented with a rear Japanese artist's studio, timber-framed structure, panoramic glazing, and sedum roof.

properties.title: Material Store reached built status in Hayes
properties.explanation: A residential block within the Old Vinyl Factory redevelopment was documented as complete with build-to-rent homes and townhouses.

properties.title: The Minster Building refurbishment reached built status
properties.explanation: A 1990s office complex at 3 Minster Court was documented as refurbished with renewed workplace, cafe, restaurant, bar, and retail space.

properties.title: The Moorgate aparthotel reached built status
properties.explanation: Four London Wall properties were documented as converted into 27 serviced aparthotel suites.

properties.title: Mountview welcomed students to its Peckham home
properties.explanation: A new theatre-training, rehearsal, performance, and community-use building entered education use in central Peckham.

properties.title: One Blackfriars completed on the South Bank
properties.explanation: A 50-storey residential tower, hotel block, retail space, basement amenities, and public piazza were completed on the South Bank.

properties.title: RAF Museum London transformation was officially opened
properties.explanation: A transformed museum site at Hendon entered public heritage use with new galleries, refreshed buildings, visitor facilities, and landscape works.

properties.title: Royal Academy of Music theatre and recital hall opened
properties.explanation: A refurbished theatre and new rooftop recital hall entered use within the Royal Academy of Music campus.

properties.title: Royal Academy new campus opened
properties.explanation: A new public route and restored cultural spaces connected Burlington House with Burlington Gardens.

properties.title: Royal Opera House Open Up transformation reopened public areas
properties.explanation: Major public-facing foyer, entrance, circulation, and theatre works entered use at the Royal Opera House.

properties.title: The Scalpel reached documented completion at 52 Lime Street
properties.explanation: A new high-rise commercial office tower entered the City of London skyline and office stock.

properties.title: Science Gallery London opened at Guy's Campus
properties.explanation: A transformed university campus building entered public gallery and art-science cultural use beside Guy's Hospital.

properties.title: South London Gallery Fire Station opened
properties.explanation: A Grade II listed former fire station entered public gallery, studio, education, archive, kitchen, and terrace use.

properties.title: Hayward Gallery and Queen Elizabeth Hall reopened
properties.explanation: A major brutalist arts complex returned to public cultural use after refurbishment.

properties.title: Stratosphere at Stratford was listed as built
properties.explanation: The project record documents two linked buildings of 36 and 11 storeys with 342 homes, retail space, office space, leisure facilities, and a rooftop garden.

properties.title: Television Centre reopened as a mixed-use district
properties.explanation: A former broadcasting campus re-entered public, residential, office, hotel, and leisure use at White City.

properties.title: Tintagel House workspace fit-out reached built status
properties.explanation: The Albert Embankment building was documented with flexible workspace interiors for The Office Group.

properties.title: U.S. Embassy opened in Nine Elms
properties.explanation: A new diplomatic building entered operational public-facing use in the Nine Elms regeneration area.

properties.title: Victoria Tube station became step-free after major upgrade
properties.explanation: A major Underground interchange gained step-free access and expanded station circulation after a multi-year modernisation programme.

properties.title: Westminster Abbey Diamond Jubilee Galleries opened
properties.explanation: The Abbey's medieval triforium entered public museum use through a new tower, lift, and staircase insertion.
